controlling_basis: This conversation; latest explicit teacher instruction takes precedence.
priority: Creator needs first; creator defaults selected automatically; sharing through optional isolated recalibration.
status: planning handoff only; no GitHub issues or repository changes created

phases.title: Establish the implementation baseline
phases.goal: Recover trustworthy source and evidence before editing; distinguish source code, installed package, host integration and classroom validation.
phases.exit_gate: A pinned commit, capability/status inventory, host/storage decision, approved decision ledger, baseline metrics and executable known-failure fixtures are recorded.

phases.title: Make the skill yours by default, with real persistence
phases.goal: Ship the creator's confirmed preferences automatically while keeping calibration reusable and saved changes scoped and auditable.
phases.exit_gate: A clean installation uses creator defaults; saved and dated overrides survive new sessions and updates; no learner placement depends on enrolment year.

phases.title: Complete the reliable agent execution path
phases.goal: Verify and extend the existing orchestration and release infrastructure; connect actual host executions and canonical assembly.
phases.exit_gate: A real component run, critic, assembly and independent review complete through the repository path; missing integrations, stale evidence and exhausted budgets fail closed.

phases.title: Approve a feasible instructional plan before full authoring
phases.goal: Turn teaching intent, prerequisite evidence, time, teacher attention and resources into an executable delivery plan.
phases.exit_gate: Generation consumes an approved, hash-bound delivery plan; incompatible resources or infeasible essential scope cannot be hidden by a declared minute total.

phases.title: Produce and release classroom-usable materials
phases.goal: Fix the reviewed failure classes and implement the retained authoring, display, accessibility, operability and quality controls.
phases.exit_gate: A representative pack using creator defaults passes deterministic checks and independent semantic/rendered/classroom-delivery review for its exact artefacts, then is validated by the teacher for a pilot.

phases.title: Adapt across days using teacher-confirmed learning evidence
phases.goal: Add optional learning state, purposeful retrieval and feedback without inventing mastery or requiring a student database.
phases.exit_gate: Multi-day evaluations respond appropriately to supported versus independent evidence, changing misconceptions and retrieval history; no-history use remains supported.

phases.title: Improve editing, sharing and quality-adjusted efficiency
phases.goal: Add the remaining portability and productivity capabilities without regressing the creator's default experience.
phases.exit_gate: Personalisation, edits, partial regeneration, model routing and profile additions are measured and isolated; unsupported coverage and savings are never fabricated.

phases.title: Close the evaluation, installation and classroom feedback loop
phases.goal: Graduate features using held-out evidence and actual installation, monitor outcomes and retain a rollback path.
phases.exit_gate: The accepted package is identified in the target host, regressions are tracked, saved settings survive rollback/upgrade, and observed classroom outcomes inform the next bounded changes.

issues.title: Freeze decisions and supersessions
issues.scope: Create a controlling decision ledger from this conversation. Later explicit teacher instructions override earlier proposals and briefs. Distinguish confirmed defaults, retained feature proposals, superseded variants and unresolved deployment facts.
acceptance_tests: Creator-first defaults, Year 5 direction, Year 3/4 retrieval, point-of-need teaching and remembered scoped overrides are explicit.
Every retained idea maps to an issue; numerical suggestions are not falsely labelled teacher-approved defaults.
Old runtime-only creator settings, forced recurring setup and year-based task streams are marked superseded.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Pin and audit the real baseline; retire invalid patches
issues.scope: Record the accepted Git SHA and dirty state; inspect open work before branching. Classify each backlog capability as absent, partial, implemented-unverified, verified or active. Archive earlier hand-written patches as superseded rather than applying them.
acceptance_tests: The existing v2 patch is recorded as syntactically corrupt; no invalid patch is an input to implementation.
Source commit, installed ZIP/manifest and active-host version are distinguished.
Audit identifies controlling Markdown, Python checks, schema producers/consumers, packaging and test fixtures for each change.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Choose and verify the deployment and persistence path
issues.scope: Inspect the actual host before choosing a settings backend. Use persistent local storage for a local runner or an authenticated private store for a hosted runner. Select one real host path first; do not build every provider. Identify agent, critic, reviewer, assembly, render and storage capabilities.
acceptance_tests: A new-session write/read probe succeeds on the selected backend, or persistence remains explicitly unsupported.
Actual host commands and independent execution capability are documented without credentials in the repository.
Unverified host facts are not filled using earlier assistant claims.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Capture the reviewed deck as a diagnostic regression
issues.scope: Extract minimal synthetic fixtures for pacing, task access, year-proxy differentiation, representation/coherence and render defects. Preserve the original review and artefact hash locally where appropriate. Do not promote the flawed deck to a gold standard.
acceptance_tests: Timing from the review is labelled supplied review evidence until authoritative timetable is recovered.
Clipping is tracked as reported and target-environment verification required, not assigned an invented root cause.
Existing quarter-kilogram modelling and correct writing prompt/model order are not incorrectly treated as absent.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Establish bounded coding-agent work rules
issues.scope: Define /change, /regress, /audit and /release roles; one implementer per bounded issue and an independent adversarial reviewer. Use isolated branches/worktrees and restrict files to owning contracts. Integrator controls shared schema merges.
acceptance_tests: Reviewer gets the issue, diff and evidence but not the implementer's private reasoning.
Each PR carries scope, dependencies, migration, negative tests, package impact and rollback.
Release agents cannot silently repair or fabricate PASS; no giant feature branch combines the roadmap.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Measure a reproducible baseline and establish evaluation scaffolding
issues.scope: Define metrics before changes: teacher preparation, observed duration, copying/display friction, critical defects, recurrence, manual corrections, schema/routing/repair quality and available latency/token/cost data. Separate synthetic tests, live model evaluations and classroom evidence.
acceptance_tests: A baseline report records known values and unknowns without guessed costs or outcomes.
Known-good controls accompany injected failures; evaluations do not reward slide count alone.
The first-pilot scenario and review rubric are fixed before tuning.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Ship creator defaults automatically
issues.scope: Create one authoritative non-sensitive built-in configuration: predominantly Year 5 main direction, Year 3/4 foundational retrieval, point-of-need differentiation and creator-first use. Missing classroom configuration selects it automatically. Do not invent jurisdiction codes, school dates, class sizes or resources.
acceptance_tests: A clean installation uses the creator direction without a setup wizard or preset activation.
Defaults are centralised, not copied as hard-coded assumptions into each content agent.
A missing configuration and a failed/corrupt configuration load have different outcomes; load failure does not silently reset defaults.
retained_ideas: teacher preferences separated from universal pedagogy
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Create a profile registry and calibrated coverage model
issues.scope: Separate curriculum anchor, retrieval band, language/representation guidance, subject-specific calibration, jurisdiction mapping and maturity. Replace hard-coded profile discovery with a validated registry. Coverage is a support claim, not a learner ceiling.
acceptance_tests: All JSON examples validate including schema references; profile IDs, status, references and domain coverage agree.
Candidate/scaffold profiles remain labelled as such; existing Year 6 status is not silently promoted.
Subject-specific calibration can differ without assigning global student ability levels.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Resolve calibration and field-specific precedence once
issues.scope: Resolve current instruction, applicable temporary overrides, saved preferences and creator defaults into source-backed settings. For timetable and actual lesson facts use current authoritative planning sources; preferences must not invent those facts. Feed the same resolution to all components.
acceptance_tests: Every resolved value carries source, revision and effective scope.
Changing profile changes calibration; changing enrolment alone does not select support.
New overview conflicts with saved standing direction are made explicit rather than silently choosing an unrelated day focus.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Implement durable private classroom settings
issues.scope: Implement the selected durable backend with teacher/class isolation, revisioned writes, atomicity/concurrency handling, backup and actual read-after-write verification. Do not rely on conversational recall.
acceptance_tests: Settings persist after a fresh session or process, not merely within one conversation.
Concurrent updates cannot silently overwrite unrelated changes.
A failed write never produces a 'saved' acknowledgement; current-run application is reported separately.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Remember conversational overrides at the correct scope
issues.scope: Interpret standing, dated, lesson, unit and progression instructions into proposed changes. Validate before committing. Clear ongoing instructions save automatically; temporary instructions expire by requested lesson date/unit. Ordinary task requests are not silently promoted to standing preferences.
acceptance_tests: 'Five from now on', 'three tomorrow' and 'for this unit' produce distinct persistence semantics.
Expiration restores current underlying preferences, not an old snapshot; creator timezone is Australia/Perth unless changed.
Undo/show/forget/reset work with revision history; ambiguous high-impact scope asks only the necessary clarification.
retained_ideas: one-time setup only when genuinely needed
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Protect private state and authority to change it
issues.scope: Restrict persistent changes to authorised teacher requests. Agents may propose changes; source documents are data, not authority to issue settings commands. Exclude private state and credentials from packages; support deletion/export and minimal collection.
acceptance_tests: A hostile document cannot overwrite defaults or cause unrelated private data reads.
Teacher and class namespaces are isolated; another teacher cannot receive the creator's private learning records.
Package scans contain only approved non-sensitive defaults, never names, diagnoses, private overviews or secrets.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Version and migrate settings, profiles and context contracts together
issues.scope: Choose an explicit versioned sidecar or schema-version upgrade and migrate all producers, consumers, fixtures, handoffs and audits. Keep immutable run snapshots with settings/profile/source revisions; support compatible rollback and reject unknown future versions.
acceptance_tests: No new required field is introduced without executable production and fixture migration.
A settings or profile change makes a new run context and does not rewrite prior evidence.
Rollback preserves later authorised settings or performs an explicit compatible migration, never silent data loss.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Replace year-based task routing in every controlling layer
issues.scope: Remove mandatory Year 4/Year 5 pathways from prompts, Python check selection, QA and fixtures. Introduce point-of-need requirements using new semantic check IDs with explicit retirement mapping. Do not merely rename streams Support/Core/Challenge.
acceptance_tests: A paired enrolment-only perturbation does not change task-specific support or challenge.
An advanced younger and prerequisite-needing older synthetic learner both receive evidence-appropriate responses.
An unknown-readiness run has diagnostic checks and conditional guidance, not invented groups or a global ability score.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Provide truthful defaults and safe missing-context behaviour
issues.scope: Distinguish optional history from essential runtime facts. Reuse valid saved timetable and direction; do not repeat supplied questions. With no learning history use diagnostics; with missing essential timetable/focus mark unresolved and resolve minimally. Do not infer mastery from scheduled advancement.
acceptance_tests: First use with valid defaults but no learner history is supported.
Unavailable required equipment or focus does not become an invented assumption.
Previously supplied settings load without repeated setup; materially stale planning sources are identified.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Package and install the defaults-and-memory increment
issues.scope: Build the first usable increment for the selected host. Include all public schema/reference/runtime dependencies; keep host secrets private. Verify install identity and load/write settings in a new host session.
acceptance_tests: Clean installed package—not repository checkout—resolves creator defaults and persisted overrides.
Corrupt/missing backend failures and class isolation are tested.
Manifest/commit of the active installation matches the accepted increment.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Verify and extend the executable registry and dependency graph
issues.scope: Reuse existing registry roles and graph. Validate references, cycles, duplicates, repeated timetable instances, required barriers, max concurrency and role ownership. Derive compatibility discovery from one authority when feasible.
acceptance_tests: Independent components can run concurrently; real content dependencies cannot be bypassed.
Repeated Mathematics blocks remain separate instances.
Registry changes cannot silently remove critic/review/release requirements.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Enforce minimum necessary context and instructions
issues.scope: Project only relevant approved settings, sources, calibration, plan and evidence into each agent. Mandatory references remain explicit; conditional references use validated rules. Specialists cannot reinterpret timetable or silently change settings.
acceptance_tests: Every generator receives identical governing calibration bindings and its own instance.
Unrelated component content and private data are not supplied unnecessarily.
Missing required projected fields fail before paid generation rather than being silently skipped.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Validate immutable handoffs and execution states
issues.scope: Verify schema/semantic identity checks, invocation states, unique attempts, hash bindings, atomic writes and confined file scopes. Receipts and transcripts come from the actual host; different labels alone do not prove independence.
acceptance_tests: Malformed, duplicate, stale, wrong-owner and path-escaping results are rejected.
PASS becomes stale after inputs change; retries use new invocation IDs and preserve old records.
Logical write scopes are not misrepresented as an operating-system sandbox.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Connect real agent executions and canonical assembly
issues.scope: Connect the selected host to component agents, Mathematics critic and independent reviewers. Supply repository-conforming ContentSource assembly and final rendering. Verify actual credentials/config privately; no provider integration is assumed.
acceptance_tests: Run a real component milestone first, then a real candidate pack with briefing.
No configuration, render or independent reviewer means no classroom-ready claim.
Synthetic adapters and assemblers remain test-only and cannot masquerade as classroom generation.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Keep QA centralised, explicit and independent
issues.scope: Reuse one QA requirement registry, partitioning semantic, rendered and deterministic coverage. Retain an explicit Mathematics critic where required. Reviewers report evidence and defects; they do not edit content or invent a broad PASS.
acceptance_tests: Expected targets are covered exactly once with evidence bound to candidate hashes.
QA cannot be invoked opportunistically in the generator context and count as independent.
Requirement method/owner changes are tested; no duplicate competing QA policy systems.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Route bounded repairs to owners and invalidate evidence
issues.scope: Batch reviewer defects by canonical instance/owner, separate transport retries from repairs while sharing bounded budgets, and stop on unresolved pack-level ambiguity. Reuse untouched content; rebuild and rerun complete applicable QA after content changes.
acceptance_tests: Multiple defects do not cause one rebuild per defect.
A literacy repair cannot silently rewrite writing or Mathematics.
Exhausted budgets, malformed reviews, missing defects for FAIL and stale accepted pointers leave an unreleased candidate.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Enforce one release authority across every entry point
issues.scope: Bind canonical content, plan, resource set, settings revision, renders and reviews to the delivered candidate. New plan checks must apply to direct finalisation as well as orchestration. Preserve package provenance and explicit warning disposition.
acceptance_tests: A direct build invocation cannot bypass new policy requirements.
Changed content, plan, resources or renders invalidate dependent review and release.
Transport success and component PASS are never conflated with complete-pack release.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Resolve lesson intent and a single learning claim
issues.scope: Operationalise existing lesson-mode guidance across components: introduce, consolidate, diagnose, intervene, extend or assess. State the essential learning claim and distinguish must-learn, must-practise and optional enrichment.
acceptance_tests: Changing intent changes modelling/evidence appropriately, not merely the heading.
Every activity has a learning, retrieval or necessary classroom-operation purpose.
No duplicate new Mathematics intent framework contradicts the existing canon.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Create the pre-authoring delivery-plan contract and gate
issues.scope: Use existing specialists in a compact planning pass. Collect activity IDs, durations, task types, dependencies, groups/participants, attention, resources, display access and reveal conditions. Approve the combined plan before expensive full authoring; revised plans require new validation.
acceptance_tests: Schema-valid but semantically incomplete plans are rejected.
Full authoring cannot start before approved plan bindings exist.
Final canonical tasks map back to plan activities; unplanned additions require revalidation.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Audit elapsed time and teacher attention
issues.scope: Account for reading, thinking, response, modelling, discussion, feedback, setup, transitions and contingency. Compute concurrent elapsed time correctly and enforce exclusive teacher/resource demands. Declared time totals are not proofs of realistic student work.
acceptance_tests: An overfilled activity plan fails even when estimated_minutes claims it fits.
Independent simultaneous tasks may overlap; incompatible exclusive teacher activities do not.
A human/model reviewer evaluates task-duration plausibility separately from schedule arithmetic.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Model resources, setup, copying and display friction
issues.scope: Record equipment availability, quantities, locations and setup/cleanup, printing and log-in costs, display/app changes and copying burden. Treat friction/screen-change metrics as diagnostic indicators initially, not universal thresholds.
acceptance_tests: One scale cannot support multiple exclusive concurrent uses.
Required printing/copies derive from authoritative resource/class data, not guessed counts.
Transcribing instructions or diagrams is distinguished from writing a learning response.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Create dependency-safe short and technology-fallback lesson routes
issues.scope: Define the minimum viable lesson and optional branches. Time reduction removes enrichment first and checks prerequisites; if essential learning cannot fit, narrow scope explicitly rather than compressing everything. Plan a board/briefing route for technology failure.
acceptance_tests: Removing a model cannot leave unsupported independent work in the short route.
A lost-time request produces a feasible alternate plan or an explicit scope blocker.
Fallback does not depend on the failed projector, unavailable equipment or duplicate full-slide printouts.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Make diagnostic point-of-need responses explicit
issues.scope: Specify observable checks, conditional support, rechecks, fading and connected extension. Allow a time-bounded prerequisite goal when a shared task remains inaccessible. Keep routes in teacher guidance where possible rather than expanding every branch into slides.
acceptance_tests: Scaffolds address the diagnosed difficulty instead of lowering all task demands.
A learner can use one support while attempting demanding reasoning.
No-history plans give unassigned conditional routes; changing enrolment alone leaves them unchanged.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Resolve shared instructional threads before parallel authoring
issues.scope: Approve compact transfer targets across related components. Link Reading and Writing craft goals; connect relevant prerequisite checks to Mathematics without converting cumulative Numeracy retrieval into a compulsory lesson preview.
acceptance_tests: Related agents receive the same approved target and can still run concurrently.
A task must show how it supports the target, not merely share a theme.
Shared and Guided Reading remain distinct according to their owning contracts.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Track uncertainty and evidence-backed plan decisions
issues.scope: Log source-backed decisions, omissions, assumptions and conflicts at decision level. Use evidence availability and justified uncertainty rather than uncalibrated model confidence percentages. Missing optional evidence can trigger a diagnostic; material missing facts block the affected claim.
acceptance_tests: The teacher can inspect why a scaffold, retrieval item or omission exists.
No-prior-learning evidence cannot become a confident readiness assumption.
Low-evidence planning and disagreement trigger a relevant check or escalation, not automatic release.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Offer lesson styles without changing pedagogical invariants
issues.scope: Support lean, standard, high-support and relief-teacher styles as explicit options. They alter presentation and guidance density, not curriculum claims, student labels or mandatory evidence. Do not silently save an assistant-suggested style as the creator's preference.
acceptance_tests: A style swap retains the same governing objective and point-of-need access.
A lean pack does not remove necessary modelling or task instructions.
Relief mode adds usable teacher guidance within the same time/resource constraints.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Generate coordinated student, teacher and resource outputs
issues.scope: Use canonical task/document IDs for projected text, teacher guide, answers and actual resources. Teacher guidance covers timing, noticing, diagnostic branches, advance/reveal points and optional adaptations. The assembler cannot invent pedagogical prose.
acceptance_tests: Deck, briefing and task resources agree on wording/data/answers through canonical references.
Required resources are present and included in release bindings.
Generation and review traces preserve task ownership across all deliverables.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Resolve warm-up quantity and selection from time and policy
issues.scope: Resolve warm-up count once from authorised preferences and available time. Start the reviewed ten-minute literacy case with five sequences as a proposed, testable planning value, not a universal permanent preference. Use the configured retrieval band, maintain self-contained prompts and feedback, and reduce superficial cognitive switching.
acceptance_tests: Ten-minute fixture with five appropriately brief sequences is reviewed for feasibility; thirty-slide overload is caught.
A longer or explicitly overridden block is not rejected solely for a different count.
Generation, deterministic audits and independent QA consume the same count/policy; cumulative Numeracy remains distinct from new teaching.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Use purposeful representation progression and authentic measurement
issues.scope: Connect representations, language and notation; use concrete/authentic instruments, approximate readings and units where the objective warrants them. Include practical work only with confirmed resources. Strengthen existing quarter-kilogram representation rather than duplicate it as though absent.
acceptance_tests: Mass fixtures distinguish genuine instrument reading from number-line arithmetic.
Representations are mathematically exact or explicitly approximate as intended.
Equivalent quality tests cover at least one non-measurement concept; no mass-only hard-coding.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Design meaningful variation and control unintended novelty
issues.scope: Specify what changes and stays invariant across examples; audit prerequisite modelling, unfamiliar notation, decimals, vocabulary, context and response format. Treat novelty as a reviewable design record, not a fabricated universal numerical budget.
acceptance_tests: Independent examples do not introduce unmodelled demand accidentally.
Fewer well-varied tasks distinguish understanding from imitation.
Difficulty caused by confusing wording or presentation is identified separately from intended conceptual challenge.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Stop authoring when the instructional purpose is satisfied
issues.scope: Require evidence that the intended concept, critical variation, guided response and independent check are covered; then stop. Additional examples need a stated purpose and budget. Slide count is an output, with 65–75 only a reviewed-pack revision reference.
acceptance_tests: A locally useful extra activity is rejected or made optional when it duplicates coverage or exceeds time.
Compression cannot lower fonts, remove essential practice or break answer separation just to meet a count.
The stop condition is observable coverage, not a model's generic 'complete' assertion.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Make reading text-dependent and writing models appropriately sequenced
issues.scope: Connect Shared Reading questions to the approved craft/comprehension target, preserve answers supported by displayed text and paragraph/question constraints, and retain Writing's modelling/joint/independent/revision sequence. Add teacher holds before independent model reveals.
acceptance_tests: Reading questions require the actual text, not generic background knowledge.
The reading-to-writing transfer is explicit without adding unnecessary sequences.
Independent model answers follow and are held until student attempts; correct existing ordering is preserved.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Design inspectable responses and discriminating exit evidence
issues.scope: Map models/tasks/exits to the learning claim; record response mode and opportunity to respond. Distinguish participation, completion and learning evidence. Use error patterns to discriminate misconceptions where justified; record assistance rather than a universal numerical ability ladder.
acceptance_tests: Watching, copying or turn-and-talk is not automatically counted as evidence of independent mastery.
Exit questions can reveal the target misconception and its alternatives with cautious interpretation.
Teacher guidance explains what response to inspect and what it warrants next.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Audit language and accessibility without lowering the intended concept
issues.scope: Review language complexity separately from mathematical demand; support vocabulary while preserving accurate terminology. Check contrast, non-colour cues, accessible reading order, image descriptions, projected readability and print accessibility as appropriate to actual outputs.
acceptance_tests: Simplifying language does not silently change the mathematical goal.
Colour is not the sole carrier of meaning; a print-safe pathway remains legible.
Accessibility claims specify what was actually checked rather than asserting universal compliance.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Guarantee persistent task access
issues.scope: Validate access throughout independent activity, not just the presence of tasks. Use readable shared tasks, concurrent optional support, or supplied resources. Do not recreate year streams or accept copying instructions as the default access solution.
acceptance_tests: Advancing to another task cannot remove required instructions from active learners without an actual alternative.
Resource references resolve to complete matching tasks and quantities.
Dual layouts pass rendered legibility, not merely geometric containment.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Fix rendering and verify the actual playback environment
issues.scope: Reproduce reported clipping using target software/fonts and actual final renders. Record substitutions and limitations. Fix owning layout/template code when reproduced; do not blame mathematical content or claim source geometry proves a clean render.
acceptance_tests: Rendered fixtures catch clipped headings, safe margins and effective text size.
Review covers actual final artefacts and relevant environment, not only a surrogate render.
Unreproduced original clipping remains documented; no fabricated root cause or unsupported claim of repair.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Improve visual navigation while preserving the approved grammar
issues.scope: Introduce purposeful section/resumption cues, consolidated practice layouts and optional simultaneous task/support layouts. Preserve semantic colours, whitespace and readability. Avoid decorative variety or dividers that add useless clicking.
acceptance_tests: Navigation improves without adding avoidable pacing load.
Layout variation preserves approved visual standards and canonical content.
Consolidation cannot reveal an answer or make one group's task disappear.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Formalise intended answer-reveal states
issues.scope: Represent prompt, student attempt, teacher check, reveal and feedback as intended states. Validate order and hold notes. Static slides can communicate but cannot enforce elapsed time; any interactive enforcement needs a genuinely capable host.
acceptance_tests: No prompt includes its hidden answer prematurely.
Independent writing/retrieval has explicit teacher advance conditions.
Documentation distinguishes static intent from enforced interaction and does not claim students were prevented from seeing an answer.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Produce the minimum viable board/briefing fallback
issues.scope: Deliver the planned emergency route with a concise key model, task, answers and exit check, linked to canonical content. Include only authorised minimal resources; do not produce a redundant printed deck.
acceptance_tests: A reviewer can execute the core lesson without the projector.
Fallback and main pack answers remain consistent.
Reduced-time and no-tech routes do not assume incompatible equipment.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Detect redundancy and apply owner-approved compression
issues.scope: Compare structural and semantic overlap within/across components, distinguish useful deliberate retrieval from duplication, and propose consolidation. Route content changes to owners; apply layout-only merges only when bindings, visibility and reveal order remain valid.
acceptance_tests: Morning Work/Numeracy duplication is reviewed without eliminating intentional cumulative retrieval.
Compression never rewrites accepted canonical pedagogy behind the owner's back.
A semantic/content change reopens affected planning and all applicable pack QA.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Gate classroom readiness on five independent dimensions
issues.scope: Add evidence for correctness, learnability, deliverability, accessibility and operability to the existing QA policy. Require an activity walkthrough: teacher action, learner action, visible resources and credible timing. Separate deterministic invariants from judgement and heuristic warnings.
acceptance_tests: A mathematically accurate pack fails classroom-ready status for material access, pacing or rendering failures.
Teacher overrides can adjust preferences or waive permitted warnings with provenance, not waive wrong answers, missing evidence or critical access defects.
All new requirement IDs have complete expected coverage and exact artefact/plan/resource bindings.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Introduce optional instructional state separate from settings
issues.scope: Record concept-specific previously taught, current focus, not-yet-taught, supplied observations, misconceptions and support conditions. Keep configuration stable and learning state changing. Class/skill level is sufficient initially; names and student databases are not prerequisites.
acceptance_tests: No-history runs retain diagnostics and do not block solely for absent learner records.
Planned, taught, attempted, supported success, independent success and transfer are distinct.
Global attainment labels are not inferred from isolated answers.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Append teacher-confirmed events and version learning snapshots
issues.scope: Append sourced dated observations with teacher authority and support conditions. Agents can propose interpretations but cannot record mastery merely from generation. Corrections supersede events explicitly; each next run uses an identifiable snapshot.
acceptance_tests: Generating or releasing a pack creates no false 'taught' or 'mastered' record.
Supported success does not automatically trigger independent mastery.
Editing later observations does not rewrite earlier pack evidence.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Make post-lesson feedback inexpensive and useful
issues.scope: Provide concise timing, difficulty, completion, changed activities and misconception feedback. Accept ordinary language as well as optional controls. Save observations at their stated granularity and distinguish class feedback from individual evidence.
acceptance_tests: A brief teacher note updates the appropriate event without requiring a full assessment form.
Completion/cancellation affects progression; timing feedback does not invent ability.
The teacher can inspect, correct and remove saved feedback.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Build a configurable retrieval scheduler
issues.scope: Select previously taught skills using recency, independent/supported outcomes, importance, interference and curricular relevance. Use configurable spacing/interleaving intervals with documented rationale, not unsupported universal forgetting claims. Cold start follows authorised overview and retrieval band.
acceptance_tests: Recently insecure skills and long-unretrieved secure skills are considered for different reasons.
Weights, intervals and overrides are visible and testable; missing results are not guessed.
Question count and selected items fit the activity budget and do not turn retrieval into new teaching.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Maintain a task-specific misconception ledger
issues.scope: Track source, concept, observed error pattern, support used, last check and active/resolved/uncertain state. Use cautious teacher-reviewed interpretations rather than asserting a diagnosis from a single wrong answer.
acceptance_tests: Active misconceptions influence relevant diagnostics and practice.
Evidence can reduce checking frequency and allow scaffold fading.
Resolved status requires appropriate evidence, not the agent's own corrected answer.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Build a modest evidence-backed concept dependency graph
issues.scope: Represent the dependencies required by validated concept families first; link difficulties to a prerequisite rather than dropping a learner to a whole year level. Separate concepts from jurisdiction codes and capture sources, caveats and maturity.
acceptance_tests: Scale-reading failure can distinguish interval structure, endpoint difference and unit knowledge.
Cycles, unsupported dependencies and missing mappings are flagged.
The graph is not treated as a complete cognitive model or as authority to invent learner mastery.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Use evidence conditions to adapt and fade support
issues.scope: Choose maintain, recheck, fade, intervene, consolidate or extend using task-specific evidence and teacher-authorised rules. Preserve uncertainty where evidence is sparse. Do not implement a universal 0–5 ability/ZPD score.
acceptance_tests: Guided success alone does not remove all support.
Independent success can justify fading and later transfer checks.
A need in one skill does not lower unrelated demands or permanently label the learner.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Expose an instructional decision and slide/task provenance graph
issues.scope: Connect activities/tasks/slides to learning claims, prerequisites, misconceptions, sources, retrieval history, supports and essential/optional status. Answer why included/omitted/changed without exposing private model reasoning.
acceptance_tests: A teacher can trace a specific slide to an authorised goal or operational need.
Decisions reference actual sources/events rather than plausible invented explanations.
Regeneration and compression preserve or explicitly update those links.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Run longitudinal adaptation evaluations
issues.scope: Use multi-day synthetic cases for misconception, supported success, independent success, new transfer, missed lesson and conflicting observations. Compare with a no-history baseline and preserve held-out sequences.
acceptance_tests: The agent changes support in response to evidence rather than repeating reminders indefinitely.
Enrolment-only changes remain invariant throughout the sequence.
Reported adaptation quality is measured in evaluations; no classroom outcome is invented.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Separate curriculum jurisdiction and locale adapters
issues.scope: Map validated concepts to jurisdiction/version identifiers separately from pedagogy. Configure spelling, terminology, dates, units, punctuation and contextual conventions. Verify specific curriculum references during implementation; do not derive statutory mapping from the brainstorming.
acceptance_tests: Swapping locale does not change mathematical meaning or readiness rules.
Unknown/outdated mappings are labelled unsupported, not silently approximated.
The creator's selected direction remains the default and is regression-protected.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Add additional profiles with explicit capability maturity
issues.scope: Add candidate calibration for other year bands only with actual domain guidance and examples. Mature domains independently where justified; preserve scaffold labels until evidenced. Test creator-default isolation for every added profile.
acceptance_tests: A new profile does not silently inherit creator-specific content assumptions.
Candidate/experimental domains cannot claim full calibration merely because files exist.
A justified advanced/prerequisite task is governed by evidence and validated scope, not an enrolment ceiling.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Offer optional recalibration and a small control interface
issues.scope: Expose curriculum direction, retrieval policy, resources, lesson style and printing/display preferences. A colleague may accept creator defaults or request recalibration; extract supplied facts and ask only missing essentials. Generated profiles remain candidates until reviewed.
acceptance_tests: The creator is never forced through a wizard to activate their own defaults.
A colleague's setup does not change the shipped baseline or creator's private configuration.
Show settings, reset, undo, scope and validity are understandable without repository knowledge.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Preserve teacher edits and locks through regeneration
issues.scope: Use stable canonical IDs and explicit locks/overrides for tasks, wording and notes. Detect conflicts with changed goals, answers or sources; preserve edits where valid and require disposition for conflicts. Locked content is still subject to accuracy and QA.
acceptance_tests: Regeneration does not silently erase teacher work.
A teacher-locked incorrect answer or stale reference cannot bypass release checks.
Each edit has provenance and future regeneration preserves ownership and mappings.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Provide user-facing partial regeneration
issues.scope: Support requests such as 'revise Maths only'. Regenerate only selected owners and dependent content, preserve unaffected canonical records and teacher edits, but rebuild and repeat complete applicable QA for the changed final artefacts.
acceptance_tests: Unrelated content is byte-/ID-stable where appropriate; pedagogical dependencies are not ignored.
The workflow does not claim partial QA is sufficient after changed final content.
Scope and retained edits are explained in a concise change summary.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Allocate model effort using measured quality risk
issues.scope: Route deterministic work to code, routine authoring to suitable models and demanding conceptual/release judgement to stronger or independent reasoning. Use held-out evaluation and real cost/latency data; maintain required critic and review independence.
acceptance_tests: Lower-cost routing does not degrade critical defect recall or mandatory quality gates.
Missing pricing/usage data is reported unknown, not zero.
No extra agents are added merely to reach a role count; deployments retain bounded budgets.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Escalate bounded disagreements rather than reviewing everything twice
issues.scope: Use concrete discrepancies between deterministic evidence, generator claims and independent review to trigger a targeted second review. Record uncertainty, owner and escalation budget; unresolved conflict remains a candidate. Do not replace mandatory independent release review.
acceptance_tests: Conflicting timing/answer/representation judgements create a focused issue and evidence request.
A majority vote cannot overrule a demonstrable mathematical or provenance failure.
Agent-reported confidence alone cannot automatically waive checks.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Build an evidence-backed metrics view
issues.scope: Summarise first-pass acceptance, schema validity, routing/owner accuracy, defect recall/false positives, repair outcomes, recurrence, runtime/critical path, tokens/cost where available and teacher-observed usability. Prioritise released useful packs over raw slide throughput.
acceptance_tests: Metrics distinguish automated, model-review and teacher-observed evidence.
Quality-adjusted cost uses real denominators and does not fabricate regression-free classroom outcomes.
Reports permit comparisons against the creator baseline and held-out cases.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Make sharing, backup and upgrades explicit and safe
issues.scope: Document defaults, optional configuration, supported capabilities, private state location, export/reset, version changes and host requirements. Verify new dependencies in full and individual packages. Do not distribute private learning history or personal source documents.
acceptance_tests: A colleague can install, inspect defaults and configure a class without developer assumptions.
Creator settings survive upgrades and another teacher's changes.
Unsupported host/profile features remain labelled rather than promised.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Run layered regression and integration tests continuously
issues.scope: From the first PR, run unit/schema/semantic-negative, integration, package/clean-install and relevant model/artefact tests. At final graduation run all layers against the pinned candidate. Do not substitute prose benchmark files for executed tests.
acceptance_tests: Each schema example and migration round-trip validates.
Direct finalisation bypasses, malformed/forged evidence and stale artefacts are negative tests.
Mathematics changes cover more than one concept family; unrelated component regressions are checked.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Execute counterfactual and stress-case evaluations
issues.scope: Perturb one input at a time: enrolment, profile, intent, available time, resource removal, supported/independent evidence, locked edits and expired overrides. Include unrelated-profile and no-history controls; avoid overfitting all prompts to the original mass lesson.
acceptance_tests: Only relevant output decisions change under each perturbation.
Halved time does not halve every activity or remove dependencies blindly.
Missing equipment produces an authorised alternative or explicit blocker, not a fictitious resource.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Maintain approved gold examples and held-out cases
issues.scope: Curate teacher-approved exemplars for pacing, instruction, access and presentation across components and mature profiles. Separate visual-only exemplars, known-failure artefacts, training/calibration examples and held-out evaluation cases.
acceptance_tests: The flawed 105-slide deck cannot become the minimum quality floor.
Agents use exemplars for calibration without copying private or stale curriculum content.
Success on known fixtures is checked against held-out cases before broad release.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Package, activate and verify each accepted milestone
issues.scope: For each milestone, identify the candidate commit, build/verify packages, install in a clean location, activate the exact version in the target host, and run a fresh-session smoke test. Keep the previous working release and compatible state backup.
acceptance_tests: Merged code, built package and active host are separate recorded states.
Installation manifest matches the tested commit; stale registered skills are detected.
Rollback is rehearsed without erasing teacher settings or altering historical evidence.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Pilot the creator workflow before broader sharing
issues.scope: At the M4 usable-pack milestone, independently review a representative creator-default pack, then teacher-approve a limited classroom pilot. Record actual preparation, pacing, task access, resource friction and needed corrections. Repeat pilot for later material changes.
acceptance_tests: No candidate is used as a claimed approved pack without exact-artefact release evidence and teacher review.
Observed classroom results are distinguished from model predictions and unit-test success.
The creator's needs govern acceptance; support for additional profiles does not delay known classroom defect fixes.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Close the defect-to-regression improvement loop
issues.scope: Classify every material review finding using stable failure categories, add a minimal reproducer and positive control, route to the owner, implement and rerun checks. Track recurrence by release. Replace vague 'make better' instructions with evidence-bearing changes.
acceptance_tests: PACING.OVERLOAD, ACCESS.TASK_NOT_PERSISTENT, DIFFERENTIATION.YEAR_PROXY, VISUAL.CLIPPING and other observed classes are traceable.
A resolved issue has a passing regression and deployed version reference.
A feature without measured benefit can remain disabled or be simplified without hiding its status.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.

issues.title: Protect creator defaults across the full roadmap
issues.scope: Run creator-default invariants on every shared change. Test behavioural properties, not identical LLM wording. Verify no repeated onboarding, no year-based placement, persistent override semantics, no cross-class leakage and no unintended assistant-suggestion promotion.
acceptance_tests: Every additional profile, provider or workflow retains the creator's expected defaults.
A feature proposal becomes a permanent preference only through teacher instruction, not agent inference.
Final traceability review marks every issue verified/deployed, still experimental, superseded with reason, or blocked with explicit evidence.
issues.notes: Paths are planning touchpoints, not a claim that proposed files already exist. Verify before modifying.
